title.zh: 后得来源关系接通保留记录的绑定
title.en: Later source learning binds retained records

statement.en: Where each bearing record of a form is explained by a family world with the target, the form resolves to the target exactly where each other meaning of a repertoire without repeats is ruled out by a bearing record no family world with it explains; so later calibration can resolve earlier records.
statement.zh: 凡关涉一个形式的每条记录都被某个以目标意义为目标的族内世界解释，形式解析为目标，恰当无重复意义库中其他每个意义都被某条关涉记录排除，而没有以该意义为目标的族内世界解释那条记录；所以较晚的校准能解析较早的记录。

laws.en: For records, meanings and worlds of any type, meanings compared decidedly and a record offering a meaning exactly where a family world with that target explains it: with a repertoire without repeats holding t and each bearing record explained by a family world with target t, the candidates are exactly [t] exactly where each other meaning is ruled out by a bearing record no family world with that meaning explains.
laws.zh: 对任意类型的记录、意义与世界，意义可判定地比较，一条记录提供一个意义，恰当某个以该意义为目标的族内世界解释它：凡意义库无重复且含 t，关涉形式的每条记录都被某个以 t 为目标的族内世界解释，形式的候选恰为 [t]，恰当库中其他每个意义都被某条关涉记录排除，而没有以该意义为目标的族内世界解释它。

laws.en: For records and meanings of any type, where the target is in the repertoire and every record bearing on the form offers it, any meaning that is the form's only candidate is the target.
laws.zh: 对任意类型的记录与意义，凡目标在意义库中、关涉形式的每条记录都提供它，形式唯一的候选就是目标。

laws.en: On any run, moves read as records (meanings compared decidedly; a move offers a meaning exactly where a family world with that target explains it), a repertoire without repeats holding t, each bearing move of the first n explained by a family world with target t: the candidates after n moves are exactly [t] exactly where each other meaning is ruled out by such a move that no family world with that meaning explains.
laws.zh: 沿任意过程的一次运行，把动作读作记录（意义可判定地比较；一个动作提供一个意义，恰当某个以它为目标的族内世界解释该动作）：意义库无重复且含 t、前 n 步中每个关涉的动作都被以 t 为目标的族内世界解释时，n 步后的候选恰为 [t]，恰当其他每个意义都被其中某个关涉动作排除，而没有以该意义为目标的族内世界解释它。

laws.en: In the periphery's machine of retained naming packets, a retained packet's record offers exactly the atoms of the worlds, each a learned route under an admitted fault, whose reports are the packet's.
laws.zh: 在外围的保留命名包机器中，一个保留包的记录恰好提供这样的世界的原子：每个世界是一条已学路线加一个被允许的扰动，其报告即该包的报告。

laws.en: In the periphery's machine of retained naming packets, for every memory, fault envelope, form and target b: with a repertoire without repeats holding b's atom and each packet of the form produced by a learned route under an admitted fault with target b, the binding view resolves the form to b's atom exactly where each other meaning is ruled out by a packet of the form no such world with that meaning as atom produces.
laws.zh: 在外围的保留命名包机器中，对每个记忆、扰动范围、形式与目标 b：凡意义库无重复且含 b 的原子，该形式的每个包都由以 b 为目标、已学路线加被允许扰动的世界产生，绑定视图把形式解析为 b 的原子，恰当其他每个意义都被该形式的某个包排除，而没有以该意义为原子的这类世界产生此包。

laws.en: In the periphery's route model, learning routes from a calibration acquired through route r retains r wherever r is among the candidate routes, and a world whose route and fault are both admitted is compatible with its own reports.
laws.zh: 在外围的路线模型中，从经路线 r 取得的校准学习路线，只要 r 在候选路线中就保留 r；路线与扰动都被允许的世界与其自身的报告相容。

laws.en: In the periphery's machine of retained naming packets, where the calibration was acquired from the actual route, the target's atom is in the repertoire, and each packet of the form was emitted by that route under an admitted fault, every packet of the form is produced by a learned world with the target, and any resolution of the form is the target's atom.
laws.zh: 在外围的保留命名包机器中，凡校准取自实际路线、目标的原子在意义库中、该形式的每个包都由该路线在被允许的扰动下发出，该形式的每个包都由以目标为目标的已学世界产生，形式的任何解析都是目标的原子。

laws.en: In retrospective 36, a history of the machine of retained naming packets with two packets retained before a late calibration through the secure route, the transition record groups the two-word encoding, the two packets reread through the learned route separate both atoms, and every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms, by the original theorem and as an instance of the separation law.
laws.zh: 在保留命名包机器的历史 retrospective 36 中（两个命名包先于经安全路线的较晚校准被保留），转移记录把两词编码分组，经已学路线重读的两个包分离两个原子，每个有限编码序列都被解释为其原子的组合：由原定理得出，也作为分离律的实例得出。

laws.en: In the history retrospective 36 of the machine of retained naming packets, executing the utterance gives the response [true, false, true], ending with support 0 and 29 units used.
laws.zh: 在保留命名包机器的历史 retrospective 36 中，执行该话语给出响应 [true, false, true]，结束时支持为 0，已用 29 个单位。

laws.en: In a witness of the machine of retained naming packets where the earlier packet for the form of true came from another route and the later calibration through the secure route, only the secure route is learned, the form resolves to the atom of false, and no learned world with target true produces that packet; the same history arises from the secure route with target false under a common fault.
laws.zh: 在保留命名包机器的一个见证中，表示 true 的形式的较早包来自另一条路线，较晚校准经安全路线：只学到安全路线，形式解析为 false 的原子，没有以 true 为目标的已学世界产生该包；同一历史也由安全路线在共同扰动下以 false 为目标产生。

laws.en: In witnesses of the machine of retained naming packets: without the retained packets the utterance is not interpreted, nor with a calibration of two probes only; with the two retained reports' channels exchanged, the form of false resolves to true's atom; begun with 35 rather than 36, the utterance is interpreted, not executed; under a joint failure the route family omits, the form of true resolves to false's atom.
laws.zh: 在保留命名包机器的见证中：去掉保留包，话语不被解释；校准只有两个探测，也不被解释；交换两个保留报告的渠道，表示 false 的形式解析为 true 的原子；以 35 而非 36 起始，话语被解释却不被执行；在路线族遗漏的联合失效下，表示 true 的形式解析为 false 的原子。

hypotheses.en: The core law: records, meanings and worlds of any type; meanings compared decidedly; a repertoire without repeats holding the target; a record offers a meaning exactly where some family world with that meaning as target explains it; each bearing record is explained by some family world with the target.
hypotheses.zh: 核心律：任意类型的记录、意义与世界；意义可判定地比较；含目标且无重复的意义库；一条记录提供一个意义，恰当某个以该意义为目标的族内世界解释它；每条关涉记录都被某个以目标为目标的族内世界解释。
已有分节、原子操作、形式识别、渠道身份和报道符号解码已具备；四种路径、校准探测和扰动范围公开给定。
hypotheses.en: Grouping, atomic operations, form recognition, channel identity and reporting-symbol decoding are available; the four-route family, calibration probes and fault envelope are explicitly supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 一般正确性要求校准记录来自声明路径，且该路径覆盖每个相关早先命名记录；各记录的实际扰动在声明范围内。历史适用性不是学习器的已知答案。
hypotheses.en: General correctness requires calibration from the declared route and that same route to cover each relevant earlier naming record, with its actual disturbance admitted. Historical applicability is not a known answer supplied to the learner.

The local witness keeps the earlier grouping and composition training and draws one support unit for each reception and each calibration record; the support the report decoder's earlier training used is not counted again, and computation and storage upkeep draw none separately.
hypotheses.zh: 局部见证保留原分节与组合训练，每次接收与每条校准记录各用一个支持单位；报道解码器先前训练所用的支持不再计入，计算和存储维护不另用支持。

does_not_show.en: It does not derive all source judgments, natural language, a developmental mechanism, a complete energy model, consciousness or evolutionary psychology.
does_not_show.zh: 不推出全部来源判断、自然语言、发育机制、完整的能量模型、意识或演化心理。

does_not_show.en: The earlier selection of movements and the production of reports by others are not composed with it into one history.
does_not_show.zh: 没有把既有的移动选择与他者产生的报告再与它组合为同一历史。

does_not_show.en: It does not identify this algorithm in children.
does_not_show.zh: 不认定儿童使用此算法。

does_not_show.en: The primary evidence constrains automatic transfer but identifies no unique mechanism or evolutionary history.
does_not_show.zh: 原典证据约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一的机制或演化史。

detail.zh: 缺记录、部分校准、渠道错置、有限支持及继承的遗漏联合作用分别保留失败；真实路径改变使准确晚期校准仍可误解早先内容。
detail.en: Missing packets, partial calibration, channel misindexing, finite support and the inherited omitted joint effect preserve distinct failures; a real route change allows accurate late calibration to misinterpret earlier content.

next_delta.en: How formed access and retained source and order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, telling present reliance apart from endorsement of old content.
next_delta.zh: 在匹配的发育程序中识别已形成的通达与所保留的来源、次序信息如何引导实际使用，分开当前依赖与对旧内容的认可。

correspondence.zh: 记录内容保留而当前证据作用可改变。实际路线及新词目标不输入bindingView。控制探测不是儿童熟悉命名的同一操作；心理实现、来源身份形成、时间范围及演化起源仍需对应。
correspondence.en: Record contents persist while their current evidential role can change. bindingView receives neither the actual route nor the novel target. Controlled probes are not identical to children’s familiar naming; psychological realization, source-identity formation, temporal scope and evolutionary origin need further correspondence.

detail.zh: acquired_routes_supply_binding_coverage直接调用既有唯一绑定覆盖定理；取得的绑定再进入既有readForms、interpret和execute。
detail.en: acquired_routes_supply_binding_coverage directly invokes the existing unique-binding coverage theorem; acquired bindings enter the existing readForms, interpret and execute.

output.zh: 来源候选与旧报告相容的原子内容包含实际目标。
output.en: Atomic contents compatible with acquired route candidates and old reports contain the actual target.

input.zh: 既有绑定正确性定理要求每个相关记录覆盖目标。
input.en: The existing binding-correctness theorem requires target coverage for each relevant record.

conditions.zh: 实际路径在校准取得范围，扰动受覆盖，路径向过去的适用性明示，目标在原子操作范围。
conditions.en: Actual route retained by calibration, disturbance covered, backward route applicability explicit, target in the atomic repertoire.

detail.zh: 复用选择不自动产生保留优势的经验约束；无数据到Lean状态的已验证转换。
detail.en: Reuses the empirical limit on automatic control-to-retention advantage; no verified conversion from data to Lean states.

history.en: 14 October 2026, open-issues plan (study section 117): the claim now states the law first. New core module Becoming.CrossSituational: the law of records read through a family of explanations (resolves_explained_iff); the periphery MachineInstances: for every memory, fault envelope, form and target, the binding view resolves to the target exactly when every rival is ruled out by a packet no learned world with the rival produces (retrospective_resolves_iff); the coverage theorem follows from the law (coverage_from_law), retrospective 36 is an instance, and after a real route change the target is not produced (changed_route_unproduced).
